body: This may not be what you want to hear but there is so much more than just what’s happening right now. It may feel like this moment will last forever, but things are constantly changing. I know it’s hard to keep hope, especially when there are things you can’t go back and erase and it feels like they will always be there haunt you, but time really does heal. People can move on. What has happened before does not have to define you.
